notes.title: Bug Fix Update v1.0.6 (August 1)
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for playing [b]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/b]![/p][p]We’ve released update v1.0.6, which includes the following improvements and bug fixes:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Update Details[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed an issue where WASD keys could remain continuously pressed[/b] when playing with a keyboard in certain environments.[/p][p]This issue had previously been addressed, but was found to persist under some conditions. notes.title: Additional Update (v1.0.2) Now Live – July 25
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for playing [i]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/i]![/p][p]We’ve released an additional update (v1.0.2) that includes the following improvements:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b] Update Details[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]“Focus” can now be activated by pressing the R stick[/b][/p][p]　While pushing a treasure, pressing the R stick will help you face it more precisely.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Required coin count for earning stars is now shown on the Stage Select screen[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Other changes[/b][/p][p]　Network error codes are now displayed in greater detail when an error occurs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We will continue working to improve the gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Thank you to everyone who’s shared feedback with us![/p][p][/p][p]Based on the comments we’ve received during the ongoing Steam Next Fest,[/p][p]we’ve updated the [i]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/i] demo to make it even easier and more fun to play![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update Details[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed the angle adjustment via long press when throwing, making it quicker and easier to [b]throw[/b] treasures.[/p][/*][*][p]Relaxed the time limit for Normal stages to improve playability.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue improving the experience throughout the festival so that more players can enjoy the thrill of our rolling action.[/p][p]Be sure to check out the updated demo and give it a try![/p]
